Name: Makise Kurisu Abigail Mod (UPDATED for 1.6 - Winter and Beach sprites - CP) - Steins Gate
Author: BloodRaven417
Description:
[b][i][u]This isn't an official update from the original creator(s), I made this for my own use and decided to share it[/u][/i][/b]

I had an abundance of boredom and managed to update all the sprites to be compatible with all the new ones for the 1.6 events, corrected some errors in the original sprites (like cut pixels and displaced sprites that caused some problems when animating), also added a bikini and winter version of her sprites based on Abigail's

Also since I made them for me in particular, I disabled (I think) the option for the alternate face, I've never programmed or wrote code before so I didn't want to touch much of the content.json, so I just made both booleans redirect to the "classic" sprite

The Beach and Winter options don't have a different portrait (I suck at pixel art), but they do have different (duplicate) files in the folder so anyone can just edit the portraits without needing to touch the json for the changes to automatically apply

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1- Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3- Unzip the folder to Stardew Valley/Mods[/color]


[size=4][b]Please Refer to the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4074?tab=description]L1ttl3F00t's mod page[/url] for the config options, he's the one that made them so at least give it a visit[/b][/size]
I disabled the alternate look (it added a mouth to the sprite) because I wasn't going to use it, and I didn't want to re-edit every single sprite again
